battery_chamber_cover_latch.name: Battery-chamber cover latch
battery_chamber_cover_latch.default_function: Slide to open or close the battery-chamber cover.

battery_latch.name: Battery latch
battery_latch.default_function: Press to the side to release the battery for removal.

bluetooth_button.name: Bluetooth button
bluetooth_button.default_function: Open Bluetooth options in shooting mode; press and hold during playback to go directly to pairing.

diopter_adjustment_control.name: Diopter adjustment control
diopter_adjustment_control.default_function: Adjust the viewfinder focus until its indicators appear sharp.

disp_back_button.name: DISP (display)/BACK button
disp_back_button.default_function: Change the display view or go back; press and hold to open function-button role selection.

drive_delete_button.name: Drive button / Delete button
drive_delete_button.default_function: Display the drive-mode menu while shooting; delete pictures during playback.

fn_dial.name: Fn (function) dial
fn_dial.default_function: DEFAULT: select a filter in FILTER mode and Film Simulation in AUTO, P, S, A, M, F, Vlog, and C1/C2/C3/C4 modes.

focus_stick.name: Focus stick (focus lever)
focus_stick.default_function: Tilt to select the focus area or navigate menus; press the center to select the focus area, and to zoom in on the focus point during playback.

front_command_dial.name: Front command dial
front_command_dial.default_function: Rotate to choose an AUTO scene mode; adjust program shift in P and FILTER; choose shutter speed in S; adjust aperture in A and M when the lens aperture ring is absent or set to A; select menu tabs or pages; select quick-menu items; or view other pictures in playback.

lens_release_button.name: Lens release button
lens_release_button.default_function: Press while rotating the lens to remove it.

menu_ok_button.name: MENU/OK button
menu_ok_button.default_function: Display the menus, confirm a selection, or select a menu item.

movie_recording_button.name: Movie recording button
movie_recording_button.default_function: MOVIE RECORDING RELEASE; press to start or stop movie recording.

on_off_switch.name: ON/OFF switch
on_off_switch.default_function: Slide to ON to turn the camera on or OFF to turn it off.

q_button.name: Q (quick menu) button
q_button.default_function: QUICK MENU; display the quick menu.

rear_command_dial.name: Rear command dial
rear_command_dial.default_function: Rotate to adjust exposure compensation in P, S, A, and FILTER; choose shutter speed in M; highlight menu items; adjust quick-menu settings; or zoom during playback.

shutter_button.name: Shutter button
shutter_button.default_function: Half-press to focus and lock focus and exposure; press fully to take a photograph. In F (movie) mode or Vlog mode, press to start and stop movie recording.

touch_screen.name: Touch screen
touch_screen.default_function: Touch photography, focus-area selection, function selection, movie-optimized controls, and playback.

ladders.basis: The firmware caches ADC channel 13 at 0x2069a08 + 2 * channel (observed in an emulator run with a distinct sample on every channel), and the scanner's kind-1 predicate 0x1408834 compares that 12-bit value with the row's band. No released level is established here: it is the run's ADC sample for this channel.

rungs.basis: Band 0..961, halfwords of the factory configuration page read through the stock tag reader 0x1494794 (tags 0x3847 low, 0x3845 high); scanner row 24 of table 0x1c44990 (kind 1, source 13) for KEY_OK. The sample is the band midpoint.

Band 962..2393, halfwords of the factory configuration page read through the stock tag reader 0x1494794 (tags 0x3843 low, 0x3841 high); scanner row 23 of table 0x1c44990 (kind 1, source 13) for KEY_DISPBACK. The sample is the band midpoint.
